Config.Title: Expressions: {name}
Config.Name: Name
Config.DefaultLocked: The default entry cannot be deleted or moved
Config.DefaultHint: The default entry cannot be renamed or deleted. Leave its images empty to use the token/actor image.
Config.FaceHint: Chat card portrait. When empty: this entry's standing image → default face → token → actor image.
Config.StandHint: Tall illustration for the stage. When empty: this entry's face → default standing image → token → actor image.
Config.NoPermission: You may not edit this actor's expressions.
Config.ErrEmptyName: An expression has an empty name.
Config.ErrDuplicate: Two expressions have the same name.

Stage.ToggleLocked: The GM has locked the novel stage toggle.
Stage.BroadcastOn: Turned the novel stage on for all users.
Stage.BroadcastOff: Turned the novel stage off for all users.
Stage.ForcedOn: The GM turned the novel stage on.
Stage.ForcedOff: The GM turned the novel stage off. Use the mask button in the chat controls to show it again.
Stage.GMOnly: Only a GM can do this.

Link.NotFound: Could not link: {keywords} (no such document or not enough permission)
Link.NoPermissionCreate: You may not link to this document.

Keywords.Title: Keyword registry
Keywords.SyntaxExample: Write {open}keyword{close} or {open}keyword|label{close} in chat to link a document. Keywords not in the registry are looked up by actor, item, journal or journal page name (or journal/page).
Keywords.UuidPlaceholder: Document UUID (or drop a document here)
Keywords.DropHint: Drop an actor, item, journal or journal page onto this window to fill in its UUID.
Keywords.GMRequired: This must be handled by a GM client.
Keywords.NoGM: No GM is connected, so keywords cannot be changed.
Keywords.Timeout: The GM did not answer. Try again later.
Keywords.ErrInvalid: Enter both a keyword and a document.
Keywords.ErrType: Only actors, items, journals and journal pages can be registered.
Keywords.ErrNotOwner: You can only delete keywords you added.

Player.Title: Log player
Player.Hint: Replay the current chat log or a saved archive on the novel stage. Only you see the replay; other users are not affected. The live stage keeps updating in the background.
Player.AssetsNotReady: The novel player files were still loading, so this export has no player page. Export again in a moment.
Player.ViewerActionHint: Replay the listed (or selected) messages on the novel stage

Editor.SaveHint: Write the edited player and log JSON into the exported folder (Ctrl+S)
Editor.DownloadHint: Download the edited player page and log JSON
Editor.ConnectHint: Open the exported folder to list its images and save in place
Editor.Speaker: Speaker
Editor.Name: Display name
Editor.ClearStands: Dismiss every stand before this line
Editor.Propagate: Also change the following lines that use the same expression
Editor.NoImages: No images to choose from yet. Open the bundle folder or pick a file.
Editor.DraftFound: This log has an unsaved draft from {when}.
Editor.Downloaded: Downloaded {file}. Replace the same files in the exported folder.
Editor.WrongFolder: {file} is not in that folder. Choose the folder the player was exported to.
Editor.FolderUnsupported: This browser cannot write into folders; the edited page will be downloaded instead.
Editor.EmbeddedNote: {count} new image(s) are embedded in the page because no folder is connected.

StageEnabled.Name: Show novel stage
StageEnabled.Hint: Show a visual-novel stage (standing images and a dialogue box) over the canvas. Also toggled by the mask button in the chat controls.

PlayersCanToggle.Name: Players may toggle the stage
PlayersCanToggle.Hint: When off, the players' mask button and the dialogue close button are hidden and only the GM's show/hide for everyone applies.

HideInCombat.Name: Hide during combat
HideInCombat.Hint: Hide the stage while a combat is running.

MaxSlots.Name: Standing slots
MaxSlots.Hint: How many standing images can be on stage at once (1–6). The speaker silent for the longest leaves first.

StandLayout.Name: Standing layout
StandLayout.Hint: Spread: speakers on stage are spaced evenly. Fixed: one fixed column per slot. (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

StandHeight.Name: Standing height (%)
StandHeight.Hint: Height of standing images relative to the stage; multiplied by the actor's scale. (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

DimStyle.Name: Silent speakers
DimStyle.Hint: How standing images other than the current speaker are shown. (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

DialogueOpacity.Name: Dialogue box opacity
DialogueOpacity.Hint: (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

DialogueFontSize.Name: Dialogue font size (px)
DialogueFontSize.Hint: (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

Typewriter.Name: Typewriter effect (ms per character)
Typewriter.Hint: 0 shows lines instantly. Click the dialogue box to finish a line. (Default for all users; each user can override it in 'Novel stage display (personal)'.)

ShowRefInStage.Name: Show reference images
ShowRefInStage.Hint: For messages with keyword links, show the linked document's image/text in the middle of the stage.

OocMode.Name: OOC messages
OocMode.Hint: How messages sent without a speaker (OOC) reach the stage.

RollMode.Name: Roll messages
RollMode.Hint: How dice roll messages reach the stage.

RebuildCount.Name: Messages used to restore the stage
RebuildCount.Hint: How many recent messages rebuild the stage when you join or rebuild it.

IdleMinutes.Name: Auto exit (minutes)
IdleMinutes.Hint: Remove standing images of speakers silent for this long. 0 disables.

PickerMode.Name: Expression picker
PickerMode.Hint: Look of the expression row below the speaker bar.

InlineTag.Name: Inline expression tag
InlineTag.Hint: Start a message with an expression name in single braces, like {Smile}, to send just that message with it.

InlineTagSticky.Name: Inline tag changes current expression
InlineTagSticky.Hint: When on, the tagged expression stays selected for later messages.

LinkPermission.Name: Minimum permission for keyword links
LinkPermission.Hint: Users need at least this permission on a document to link it, open it from a link or see its reference image. GMs always can.

ExportStands.Name: Include standing/face images in exports
ExportStands.Hint: Zip/folder exports also contain the standing (stands/) and face (faces/) images used by the messages, for a future log player.

DisplayMenu.Name: Novel stage display (personal)
DisplayMenu.Label: My display
DisplayMenu.Hint: Standing height, layout, greying, dialogue opacity, font size and typewriter speed follow the GM's defaults. Override only the ones you want here.

NpcCastMax.Name: NPC cast per scene
NpcCastMax.Hint: How many NPCs each scene can keep on the stage (1–6).

CastAutoFit.Name: Fit stands automatically
CastAutoFit.Hint: Shrinks stands when many are on stage or the screen is narrow so they do not overlap much. Freely placed stands shrink with the screen's aspect ratio.

CastHud.Name: Cast cards
CastHud.Hint: Shows a stats/items card on PC cast stands (to the GM and the character's owner). A system module fills it through the API; without one nothing is shown.

NpcHud.Name: NPC cast cards
NpcHud.Hint: Whether NPC cast members show their card.

AvHighlight.Name: Voice chat highlight
AvHighlight.Hint: Highlights the stand of a user speaking in Foundry's audio/video chat (their assigned character, else the one PC cast member they own).

BubbleMode.Name: Speech bubbles
BubbleMode.Hint: Also shows a line as a bubble over the speaker's stand. Not for rolls or whispers you cannot see.

MediaHideGrid.Name: Hide grid and border with media
MediaHideGrid.Hint: On scenes with scene media, hides the grid and the scene border on your screen.

ShowQuickbar.Name: Show the scene quickbar (GM)
ShowQuickbar.Hint: Shows the GM a small quickbar with location presets and stage tools. The clapperboard in the scene controls toggles it too.

Display.Title: Novel stage display (personal)
Display.Intro: Only ticked rows use your own value. Unticked rows follow the GM's default and update when the GM changes it.
Display.IntroGM: Everyone's defaults are set in the module settings; this window changes only your own screen.
Display.Saved: Saved your novel stage display settings.

Cast.Title: Cast
Cast.Intro: Cast members stay on the novel stage whoever speaks. The PC cast appears in every scene, the NPC cast only in the scene being viewed. A cast member lights up when it speaks; everyone else still enters the stage when speaking, as before.
Cast.VisibleHint: Off keeps the seat but takes the character off the stage; it then enters like any speaker when it talks.
Cast.DropHint: You can also drop an actor from the Actors directory onto a seat. An actor takes one seat only.
Cast.WorldActorsOnly: Only world actors can join the cast. Import it first.

Media.Title: Scene Media
Media.Intro: Lays a backdrop (whole canvas) and a centre image as tiles. Changing a control previews on your screen only; nothing is saved until you press Apply. The scene's own background is never touched.
Media.BlurHint: Writes a blurred WebP of the backdrop once into the world folder (gatos-vn-blur).
Media.BlurVideo: Videos cannot get a blurred copy.
Media.NoUpload: You lack the file upload permission needed for a blurred copy.
Media.BlurDone: Blurred copy made. Press Apply to save it.
Media.BlurLoadFailed: Could not read the source image (HTTP {status}).
Media.BlurEncodeFailed: Could not encode the blurred copy.
Media.BgColorHint: Shown around and behind transparent parts of the images. Painted on each screen only; the scene configuration is not changed.
Media.HideHotbarHint: Hides everyone's macro bar while this scene has media.
Media.PresetSave: Save current values as a preset
Media.PresetEmpty: There is no image to save.
Media.ClearConfirm: Remove this scene's media tiles and settings? Presets and the scene background stay.
Media.SyncFailed: Could not create the media tiles. See the console.

Palette.ItemHint: Drop onto a PC cast stand to give that character a copy. Right-click: choose the PC. Double-click: open the sheet.
Palette.NpcHint: Click to put an actor into this scene's NPC cast or take it out.
Palette.NoPc: There is no PC cast. Set it up in the Cast window first.
Palette.More: {count} more. Narrow the list with the search or a folder.
Palette.IndexFailed: Could not read the item list.

Quickbar.Title: Scene Quickbar
Quickbar.Hide: Hide the quickbar (turn it back on in the scene controls)
Quickbar.NoPresets: This scene has no location presets. Make them in the Scene Media window.
